title: CB-Agent: Concept-Based In-Context Learning for Sequential Action Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.14574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows large language models to use demonstrations without updating their parameters. For interactive agents, demonstrations are trajectories of reasoning, actions, and observations that illustrate how to complete a task. Reusing demonstrations in new situations is challenging: directly inputting full trajectories consumes limited prompt space and constrains the overall effectiveness, while natural-language summaries require the agent to translate general guidance into specific action choices. Therefore, we study whether expert action choices can directly supervise a reusable scoring rule. We propose CB-Agent, which extends concept-based ICL to sequential action selection. We extract environment-action decisions from expert trajectories and fit a concept vector by maximum likelihood to model the conditional distribution over candidate actions given the context. translated_title: CB-Agent：基于概念的上下文学习实现序列动作选择
translated_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）使大型语言模型能够在不更新参数的情况下利用示例。对于交互式智能体而言，示例是由推理、动作和观察组成的轨迹，展示了如何完成一项任务。在新情境中重用示例具有挑战性：直接输入完整轨迹会消耗有限的提示空间并限制整体效果，而自然语言摘要则要求智能体将一般性指导转化为具体的动作选择。因此，我们研究专家的动作选择能否直接监督一个可复用的评分规则。我们提出了CB-Agent，将基于概念的上下文学习扩展到序列动作选择。我们从专家轨迹中提取环境-动作决策，并通过极大似然拟合一个概念向量，以建模在给定上下文条件下候选动作的条件分布。该模型将概念与冻结的语言模型相结合……
tldr: 提出CB-Agent，将基于概念的上下文学习扩展到序列动作选择，通过从专家轨迹中提取环境-动作决策并以极大似然拟合概念向量来建模候选动作的条件分布，从而利用专家动作选择直接监督可复用的评分规则。
en_tdlr: CB-Agent extends concept-based in-context learning to sequential action selection by extracting environment-action decisions from expert trajectories and fitting a concept vector via maximum likelihood to model the conditional distribution over candidate actions, enabling a reusable scoring rule directly supervised by expert action choices.
